title: Ayurvedic Chicken Liver Tacos
description: A Mexican-inspired twist on traditional Ayurvedic liver recipes, featuring chicken liver in a flavorful and spicy taco format.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes, until softened.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the chicken liver to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes, until browned.
Add the cumin, chili powder, and salt to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the liver is cooked through.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by placing a portion of the liver mixture onto a tortilla, followed by a spoonful of diced avocado.
Serve immediately and garnish with chopped cilantro and a squeeze of lime juice.
Serve with additional salsa, avocado, or sour cream as desired.
